freeze_clock_note: authoritative local ordering is recorded from the protocol and sidecar filesystem times, the freeze receipt, and the first run-log event
development_disclosure: Blended development seed 4400, confirmation seeds 4401--4405, and semantic-overlap confirmation seeds 4411--4415 were observed and are excluded. The 4411--4415 block failed its frozen support gate because SCAn recall was 0.650--0.884 with only one policy-passing screen. The LDA expansion and its parameters were selected after inspecting saved target-class features of 4401--4405 and 4411--4415: distance-to-reference scores (Mahalanobis, kNN, cosine) were rejected; LDA PCA dimension {16,32,64}, relative ridge {0.1,1.0}, and calibration q {0.01,0.02,0.05,0.10} were compared on 4411--4415 union recall, clean flag rate, and development certificate GO rates. dim=32, ridge=0.1, q=0.05 was chosen. Seeds 4416--4425 had not been trained or scored.
dataset: CIFAR-10 official split with a fixed 45000-row victim-training partition
population: all 45000 victim-training members; poisoned rows replace their clean training presentation and receive target label 8
architecture: CIFAR-native VGG-16-BN with 14,724,042 parameters and a 512-dimensional penultimate representation
attack: BackdoorBench-parameterized Blended all-to-one attack with frozen Hello-Kitty asset, alpha 0.2, target ship, and 2250 poisons
group_variable: assigned CIFAR-10 training label after poisoning
detector: pinned upstream BackdoorBench SCAn feature primitive, followed inside every SCAn-flagged class by a clean-calibrated LDA expansion (src/scan_lda_expansion.py); final flag = SCAn OR expansion
detector_target_information: none; expansion classes are those SCAn flags and thresholds come from clean held-out members
trusted_reference: 250 deterministic held-out clean validation members per CIFAR-10 class
calibration_definition: the 250 held-out clean validation members of each SCAn-flagged class that are not SCAn trusted references

protected_groups.name: ground_or_road_entities
protected_groups.meaning: land animals together with road vehicles; crosses the animal/vehicle partition

certificate.security_object: global poison recall at least 0.8 and clean flag rate at most 0.1 in every predeclared semantic protected set

secondary_analysis.description: nested escalation 2000->8000->16000, delta/3 per look, one-sided per-error-type tails with delta/2 to recall cells and delta/2 to group cells, flagged share 0.25; descriptive, outside the support gate

descriptive_reporting: SCAn-only recall and clean rates are recorded per seed in the score manifest and reported descriptively
stopping_rule: attempt all ten seeds without replacement or detector, expansion parameter, group, threshold, allocation, endpoint, or support-gate retuning
limitations: The freeze is internally hash-bound without a third-party timestamp.
The two-stage screen was selected on disclosed development seeds of the same dataset, architecture, and attack.
A pass would establish positive target-unknown coverage on CIFAR-10/VGG-16-BN/Blended for this screen only, not universal detector, attack, or architecture transfer.
